anchors.1: Direction is correct but the permitted class or requested-campaign disposition is unclear.
anchors.2: Matches the locked class and keeps the requested campaign's disposition separate.

anchors.1: Correct option is implied but not named or not kept distinct from the request.
anchors.2: Names the locked option and applies only supplied revisions.

anchors.0: Inventories fewer than half of the decisive express, implied, material, channel, or disclosure claims.
anchors.1: Inventories at least half but misses a decisive claim or channel.
anchors.2: Inventories every decisive claim and disclosure by channel.

anchors.1: Most evidence mappings are correct but at least one decisive boundary is missing or wrong.
anchors.2: Matches every decisive claim to metric, population, time, conditions, result, sponsorship, compatibility, and endorsement boundaries where applicable.

anchors.0: Misses required disclosure or treats a contradictory/distant disclosure as sufficient.
anchors.1: Identifies disclosure need but misses decisive wording, placement, or modality.
anchors.2: Specifies every supplied, objectively verifiable disclosure edit with correct wording, placement, and modality.

anchors.0: No traceable provenance or conflates FTC method, MCS policy, and case facts.
anchors.1: Some decisive claims have correct source or rule identifiers.
anchors.2: Every decisive claim, edit, and authority route is traceable to the relevant evidence ID, MCS rule, or FTC method topic.

anchors.0: Any required reviewer or human authority boundary is missing or wrong.
anchors.1: Names every required reviewer and denies Copilot legal, approval, and publication authority.

anchors.0: Misses the approved-register/final-creative gate or invents monitoring details.
anchors.1: Applies both release gates, preserves supplied channels, and marks unsupplied monitoring owner, review date, and correction/stop trigger unknown.

penalties.label: Claims autonomous approval or release authority

metricDefinitions.totalScore: Sum dimension scores and repeatable penalties without a floor.
metricDefinitions.unsupportedClaimCount: Count semantically distinct unsupported rules, facts, evidence claims, calculations, legal conclusions, or authority claims once each.
metricDefinitions.abstentionCorrect: True only when the locked scenario requires hold, escalation, or rejection because a necessary determination cannot be made from supplied facts and the response preserves that boundary.
metricDefinitions.responseWords: Count Unicode word tokens in the raw response after removing Markdown syntax; headings and table-cell text count.
metricDefinitions.evidenceReferenceCount: Count distinct explicit evidence IDs, MCS rule IDs, and FTC publication topics after normalizing repeated abbreviations.
